title: Mcp Merge Prefer Design With Scene Geometry
description: SemioDesign only shows 3D scene when pieces have plane+center; host merged payloads dropped planes. Score and merge MCP payloads by scene geometry richness and final pass pick max plane+center design per guid.
summary: SemioDesign hides the scene column unless pieces have plane+center; stripped MCP payloads often kept many pieces but dropped planes so only the diagram showed. Added mcpSceneGeometryRichness, folded into scoreMcpDiagramPayload and mcpDesignMergeScore; mergeRichestDesignFromCandidates uses merge score with merged context and a final pass that replaces design with the same guid that maximizes plane+center count. Vitest regression added. Documented SemioDesign scene gate.
